diagram-definition.user-facing-description: The operational flow from a new customer signup through workspace readiness.
diagram-definition.development-scope-and-focus: Track the customer onboarding workflow across signup intake, account creation, sales review, user messaging, and workspace readiness. Focus on service-level workflow and integration boundaries rather than implementation details inside individual services.

lucid-flyway.description: Created the initial customer onboarding workflow. The first version captures the branch between self-service and sales-reviewed signups, then converges on account creation, welcome messaging, and workspace readiness.
lucid-flyway.topology-changes: C^flowchart TD C^lead[Lead submits signup] C^approval{Plan requires sales approval?} C^account[Create customer account] C^review[Sales reviews request] C^email[Send welcome email] C^ready[Workspace ready] C^lead --> approval C^approval -->|No| account C^approval -->|Yes| review C^review --> account C^account --> email C^email --> ready
